_: Stand-ins (Kenney first, else CC0 from ambientCG) for stock materials an imported map's .bsp did not carry. First match wins (String.match globs, lowercase material names). 'none' keeps the tinted prototype grid. 'units' is the world WIDTH of one tile (its height is units * 'aspect', the image's height over width) in Source units; 'mean' is the stand-in's average sRGB colour, which the tint toward the map's measured colour divides by. Chosen 2026-10-04 by looking at private reference copies of the originals; those never enter this repository. [g2g-maps-stock-1]

glass: the original was translucent ($translucent in every glass VMT the reference has; the pictures are smudged tints of grey, brown and blue-black), and maps are built on that: surf_greatriver_v4's spawn is a glass box with the sky behind it. Any image on an opaque mesh (Kenney's framed window panes, a CC0 photo of glass) made that box a dark room, as the opaque grid did. So no texture: the grid in the measured colour, lifted 20%, drawn see-through at 35%, which keeps a glass floor or ramp visible and its scale readable. Chosen by rendering greatriver_v4, mai_remix and bunnyhop_pro both ways (2026-10-10)
any other untextured glass (lamp covers, the mappers' own refract panes when they did not ship): the glass treatment above, so a red lamp glass is a red see-through tint (2026-10-10)
